BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.

7. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

9. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

10. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.

11. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

12. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
